title: CSIRT KNF warns of phishing campaign posing as a PGE overpayment refund, Dobreprogramy reports
date_note: Dobreprogramy's page (24 November) gives no earlier day for the warning; the date is its publication day.
summary: Dobreprogramy reports that CSIRT KNF warns of a phishing campaign using the theme "Zwrot nadpłaty PGE" (PGE overpayment refund). The emails say the recipient is owed a refund and link to a fake site made to look like PGE's customer panel. According to the article, the site tries to collect login credentials and payment card data.
plain: Fake emails claim you are owed a refund from the energy company PGE. The link leads to a fake PGE site that, per the report, tries to collect logins and card details.
exec: Customers of the Polish energy company PGE are being targeted by a fake refund email, according to a CSIRT KNF warning relayed by Dobreprogramy.
action: Dobreprogramy's report advises checking the sender and site address, confirming the matter through PGE's official channels, and, if data was entered, contacting your bank at once and reporting the message to CERT Polska.

validation.note: Only Dobreprogramy read; CSIRT KNF's own warning was not found by search and not read.
